entities.summary: Rajmund Kupareo was a Croatian Roman Catholic priest of the Dominican Order, poet, theological writer, composer, translator and editor. He wrote in Croatian, Czech, Latin and Spanish. He spent years working as a professor of aesthetics and axiology in Santiago de Chile, Chile; he served there as the dean of the Faculty of Philosophy (twice) and the vice-rector of the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile.
